definitions.discovery: First evaluation of the full GIVE/TAKE/CLEAR witness edge; enumerated mode evaluates every ordinary outcome on that edge.
definitions.avoid: Configured temperature-zero visit policy selects a non-giveaway action.
definitions.q_prefers_avoid: Best evaluated non-giveaway Q exceeds best evaluated giveaway Q by more than 1e-8; not a claim of true optimality.
definitions.stable_through_budget: Start of the final uninterrupted true interval, censored at this trial's budget; absent if false at the end.
definitions.work: Evaluated state count includes root and continuing-round network evaluations; time includes per-iteration diagnostics and concurrent-worker contention.
